acceptanceCriteria: A heartbeat or renew that changes nothing else completes in milliseconds on a synthetic store of at least 13,000 receipts and its cost is flat from 3,000 to 13,000 receipts (median of 5, load band recorded).
Lease, generation fencing and refusal semantics are unchanged and covered by existing or new tests.
If liveness records are moved out of the audited journal, a decision and spec amendment record the contract and rollback.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

GitHub beamfall/corvint#642 (Flow-Proof queue, 13,121 receipts): attempt heartbeats are about 62% and renews about 28% of queue writes, and each pays the full-history audit (30-43 s, #641). Owner (2026-10-06): writer cost must be milliseconds, not seconds. Delivered with V1-0645 (writer checkpoint) in rc3 batch 4; moving liveness out of the audited journal is a separate contract question if the checkpoint alone is not enough.

title: corvint-tasks: heartbeats and renews must cost O(1), independent of journal history (GitHub #642)
